title: Live cloud auth: free lanes, Claude, Codex
description: Execute a bounded live cloud-authorization qualification wave from current main. First inspect provider qualification workflow, CloudFirstOrchestrator, adapters and tests. Qualify every available free-model lane without assuming a free quota: OpenRouter free models and Gemini free-tier generation where credentials are present; also qualify DeepSeek/Kimi/Perplexity when credentials are present. Add or harden direct Anthropic Claude API authorization using ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and current active model selection, while retaining OmniRoute as a separately qualified gateway path. Explicitly qualify OpenAI Codex-capable API access by cataloging available Codex model IDs and performing the standard non-empty marker inference through the OpenAI Responses API when an eligible model and credential are available; do not conflate Codex API access with ChatGPT account login. Implement only minimal evidence-backed fixes and tests required for these paths. Never read/output secrets, invent credentials, bypass auth/billing/quota/rate limits, or simulate inference. Record fresh per-provider/model PASS/BLOCKED/credential_missing evidence with timestamps, HTTP classification, model IDs (not secrets), marker confirmation and qualification status. Commit/push reviewed changes and evidence only.
